_comment: Per-string context pushed to Crowdin by `npm run i18n:context`. One line per key saying where the string appears and what constrains it — the facts a translator cannot get from the English alone. Written when the string is, by whoever ran /wording. Keys mirror en.json.
title: Dialog title for the sign-in choice. Atmospheric. One line, does not wrap.
message: Lead paragraph under that title, explaining the choice below. Two sentences.
anonymous.title: Heading of the left-hand panel: the anonymous account option. Short.
anonymous.lead: One-sentence summary under that heading, saying who the option suits.
anonymous.credentials: Bullet in the anonymous panel. Terse, parallel with the other three bullets and with the opposite panel.
anonymous.device: Bullet in the anonymous panel. Terse and parallel.
anonymous.name: Bullet in the anonymous panel. Terse and parallel.
anonymous.duration: Bullet in the anonymous panel. Terse and parallel.
credentials.title: Heading of the right-hand panel: the registered account option. Short.
credentials.credentials: Bullet in the registered panel. Reads against its opposite number in the anonymous panel.
credentials.device: Bullet in the registered panel. Reads against its opposite number.
credentials.name: Bullet in the registered panel. Reads against its opposite number.
credentials.duration: Bullet in the registered panel. Reads against its opposite number.
